messages:
frank: dropped a small build of the routing policies editor: /staging/policies/editor-v4. Quick UX + a11y pass please focused on rules builder, ordering, validation copy, and the preview simulator.
maya: nice iteration. immediate confusion: which rule is evaluated first. visual ordering reads bottom-to-top because of shadows. suggest a persistent numeric badge (1 = evaluated first) and a header hint 'Higher priority rules evaluated first'.
tony: keyboard/drag note: drag handle only appears on hover and there's no keyboard reorder. propose a row-level focus with explicit actions: Move ↑, Move ↓, Move to top, Duplicate. keyboard shortcuts: Alt+Up / Alt+Down, Alt+Home / Alt+End. add aria-grabbed when dragging.
olga: validation copy is too terse. current: 'Invalid condition'. prefer: 'Unknown attribute: request.headers["x-user-id"] in clause 2. Click "Insert placeholder" to add sample value.' also include link to docs.
frank: preview simulator is great. feature ask: batch-replay (CSV upload) and show per-request compact traces: a tiny vertical timeline with dots for evaluated/matched/fallback. hover shows why matched.
maya: microcopy tweak: replace 'Fallback to compatible variant' -> 'Fallback to secondary model (reduced capacity)'. change 'Priority' label to 'Priority (higher runs first)'.
tony: insertion behavior: when adding a new rule while a row is selected, insert above selection. add editor pref to default new-rule position (Top/Bottom).
a11y-bot: Accessibility scan: 3 issues found: 1) disabled-rule chip contrast 2.7:1, 2) draggable rows missing aria-grabbed and accessible reorder controls, 3) focus ring insufficient on row controls.
olga: action items: @tony draft keyboard + ARIA spec, @maya update copy and Figma hint, @frank prototype CSV batch replay and compact traces. i'll update validation wording and add quick-fix buttons.
frank: thanks all 680 i'll post updated frames and a short walkthrough before the next deploy. ping me to pair on keyboard tests or the accessibility follow-up.
